summary: Vizsla Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing the award of EPCM and mine design contracts for its Panuco silver-gold project. The EPCM contract, valued at approximately US$170 million, was awarded to M3 Engineering, and a mine design contract covering ~US$90 million in development and ore work was given to Mining Plus. No financial terms such as price per share or premium are involved. The awards are operational milestones, not a special situation transaction. The filing is a routine progress update on mine development.
